name: Cortado
flavor_notes: A strong, balanced coffee drink combining an espresso shot with an equal amount of warm, steamed milk.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: A little stronger than the original: Cometeer capsules can't be split. For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: Warm the milk to about 140°F (60°C) and froth it.
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it into the mug.
Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the foam on top.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Brew one Nespresso Ispirazione Roma capsule into an espresso cup.
Steam 40ml of milk until hot and slightly frothed.
Pour the steamed milk into the espresso.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: Warm the milk to about 140°F (60°C) and froth it.
Dissolve 1 tsp instant espresso in 1 oz (30 ml) hot water directly in the mug.
Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the foam on top.
